messages:
Maya: Quick thread — need a compact benchmark narrative for next week's webinar. Focus: latency vs unit cost for realistic customer workloads. Deliverable: 1 one‑pager with 3 visuals, 2 short social posts, and routing + lead-flow asks. Who can own visuals + data + copy?
Noah: I can run the data. Suggest 3-panel layout: 1) latency waterfall (P50/P95/tail) by model variant; 2) tokens→dollars Sankey that shows batching + prefix/KV cache savings; 3) regional routing heatmap overlaying cost per token and median latency.
Priya: +1. For positioning, steer away from "fastest" claims. Angle should be "predictable inference economics" and "graceful degradation under load." Hero claim example: "Same API, predictable token economics — control cost without sacrificing SLOs."
Sam: I’ll do figma mocks. Rough colors: teal/charcoal for econ, orange accent for tail latency. I’ll layout as three horizontal panels so it fits a slide and a social card. Will put small callout boxes: "batching", "cache", "routing".
Ally: Routing/lead-flow asks: segment CTA by intent: SMB self-serve trial -> product tour; Mid-market -> webinar signup + case study; Enterprise -> request demo + data privacy one-pager. Add UTM params: utm_campaign=bench_webinar&utm_segment={seg}. Also route Enterprise leads to AE queue if MQL score > 70.
Maya: Nice. Can we get two social post variants? One product-forward (short) and one business ROI (slightly longer). Also a 20‑word webinar blurb for the registration page.
Priya: Product-forward: "See how one API keeps latency predictable while trimming token spend — 3 real workloads, 3 visuals. Wed 11am PT. Register:" Business ROI: "Reduce inference spend while protecting response SLAs — a playbook for engineering and platform teams. Live demo + benchmarks." 20‑word blurb: "Benchmarks and tactics to cut inference spend without breaking latency SLOs — real workloads, routing patterns, and cost playbooks."
Noah: I’ll attach the query snippets for the Sankey and waterfall. Quick sample (psuedo-SQL):
```
-- P95 latency by model variant
SELECT model, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_ms
FROM requests
WHERE dataset IN ('chat', 'search') AND timestamp >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY model;

-- Tokens->dollars breakdown (approx)
SELECT sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(tokens) * cost_per_token AS cost, tag AS factor
FROM token_events
GROUP BY tag;
```
Will produce CSVs by EOD.
Sam: Figma link coming in thread — I'll include mobile/social crops and one-slide layout. Also will add small annotation showing how the Sankey calculates "saved tokens" from batching/cache.
Ally: For inbound routing: recommend two-tier scoring: engagement (webinar attend/clicks) + technical signal (SDK usage, api key created). If both high -> AE. If just engagement -> nurture with SMB drip.
Maya: Timeline: Noah data CSV by EOD today, Sam first mocks by tomorrow noon, Priya will finalize copy by EOD tomorrow, Ally will map routing and create UTM table. I'll assemble one-pager on Friday for design review. Assigning owners: Noah=data, Sam=visuals, Priya=copy, Ally=inbound routing. Thanks team :rocket:
Priya: Quick note on messaging: avoid absolute % claims unless we can support with closed-book appendix. Use ranges or conditional language ("up to") and always call out the workload type (dialogue vs search).
Noah: Agreed. I’ll include per-workload notes and sample data so legal/ops can review the appendix if needed.
Sam: Putting a tiny version of the routing heatmap in the slide so PMs can overlay region labels. Link to figma will be posted in #design after initial pass.
Ally: I’ll draft the webhook + automation playbook for routing and drop into the marketing drive so ops can wire it to HubSpot.
Maya: Perfect. Last ask — two CTA lines for the registration page (short): 1) "Register — see benchmark playbook" 2) "Reserve your seat — reduce inference spend". Done.
